findings.title: Java MessageFormat choice syntax introduced into i18next-based JS message bundles
findings.body: The admin-ui (and account-ui, line 188 of js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties) bundles are consumed by the React apps through i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}` placeholders, not Java MessageFormat `{0}`/`{0,choice,...}`. Replacing `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` with `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` means the placeholders are no longer substituted and the raw choice expression is rendered to end users. The sanitizer requirement (avoiding a bare `<`) should be solved differently for the JS bundles, e.g. by keeping `{{n}}` placeholders and avoiding the choice construct.

findings.title: Diff reporting can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: The prefix/suffix trimming computes `start` and `end` independently, so for overlapping cases the subsequent substring calls are invalid. Example: value="aa", sanitized="a" gives start=1 and end=1, then `sanitized.substring(1, 1-1=0)` throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Instead of reporting the offending message, the Maven plugin crashes with an unrelated exception. Clamp `end` to `Math.min(end, len-start)` for each string before substring.

findings.title: santizeAnchors removes the wrong anchor occurrence / uses stale matcher
findings.body: `value = value.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(englishMatcher.group()), "")` always strips the *first* textual occurrence of the tag in the (already modified) value, not the occurrence the matcher is currently positioned at, while `matcher` still iterates the original string. For messages with several identical anchor tags (e.g. two ``), tags are removed out of order and positions no longer line up, so legitimate strings can be flagged or malicious extra anchors can slip through unnoticed. Use the matcher's start/end offsets (or build the result with Matcher.appendReplacement) instead of replaceFirst.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart aborts verification with RuntimeException
findings.body: The English baseline path is derived purely by string replacement (`resources-community` -> `resources`, locale suffix -> `_en`). If that file does not exist (community-only themes/locales, or any bundle whose English base lives elsewhere), a RuntimeException is thrown and the whole build fails with "unable to read file ..." rather than the verifier reporting a usable message or skipping the HTML check. Handle FileNotFoundException explicitly (skip or add a descriptive message).

findings.title: Lithuanian translations replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` (Italian) in the Lithuanian bundle; the same wrong-language string was inserted in themes/.../account/messages/messages_lt.properties line 101. Lithuanian users will see Italian text. Use a Lithuanian wording (or leave the key out so the English fallback applies).

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle given Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機/應用程式) in the zh_CN (Simplified) bundle, which is inconsistent with the rest of the file. Should be e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.
